fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Objectives Editor Notes: After learning this major, graduates will gain knowledge from at least 3 disciplines. The program will culminate in a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree. Graduates will gain knowledge from nursing, humanities, and other sciences and disciplines; apply concepts and knowledge of leadership, teaching, quality improvement and patient safety in nursing; provide nursing interventions based on research findings and evidence; use critical thinking to provide holistic care across lifespan in a variety of healthcare centres. 2. Education Standard Editor Notes: International students will graduate successfully upon meeting the following requirements. Upon the completion of the program, the graduate is to meet the requirements as follows: 1. Knowledge: the graduate should have a basic understanding of nursing related natural science, humanities and social science, master the knowledge about nursing theory, human anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology; the effect of biology, psychology, social factors in the development of disease; the nursing procedure for patients with common disease and critical illness; the psychological characteristics of various patients and corresponding interventions; the health promotion for people across lifespan; a basic understanding of Traditional Chinese Medicine. 2. Quality: The graduate should demonstrate high-level professionalism, show great respect toward life, culture, belief, religion and custom; highlight innovation, critical thinking and self-directed learning; value the team-work, work collaboratively with co-workers from other disciplines; have the idea of the cost-effectiveness. 3. Skill and Ability: The graduate should have the basic skills and abilities in communicating with patients across lifespan and professionals from other disciplines; apply nursing procedure and techniques to provide high-quality holistic care to 12 different patients; apply nursing research skills to provide evidence-based nursing; provide prevention and health care in the community level; have certain communication ability with Chinese language. 3 .Core Courses Editor Notes: Students can gain lots of knowledge from core courses. The introduction to nursing (nursing theory, history), Human anatomy, Physiology, Fundamentals of Nursing-Ⅰ &Ⅱ ,Pharmacology, Pathology, Health assessment and promotion, Medical Nursing-Ⅰ &Ⅱ , Surgical Nursing Ⅰ &Ⅱ , Emergency Nursing, Maternal and infant care, Nursing care of children, Mental health nursing, Clinical Practice. 4. Learning and Teaching Strategy Editor Notes: High-fidelity patient simulation and case study will help students to learn this major deeply. The programme consists of two semesters and 16 weeks in duration per annum. Block periods of study will be followed by block periods of practice. Each 16 contact hours convert to 1 credit point (The ratio between contact hours and self-directed learning hours are 1:2-3). High-fidelity patient simulation will be systematically used to enable students to develop confidence in their practice skills within a safe and controlled environment. Case study will be integrated to offer students the opportunity to rehearse and enhance psychomotor skills. 5. Clinical Practice and Internship Editor Notes: 36 hours/week's clinical practice will enable students to apply the theoretical learning and consult with clinical tutors. It includes Clinical Practice in semester Ⅲ, Ⅳ,Ⅴ, Ⅵ, Internship. International students will work 36 hours per week in clinical practice, which enables them to apply the theoretical learning and consult with clinical tutors. Practice Placements The school collaborates with three key hospitals for the programme, and these hospitals have qualified clinical mentors for international students. These placement areas are selected and monitored with caution to ensure that they are conducive to the achievement of the learning outcomes. Evidence based nursing practice is a core aspect of the curriculum. Awareness of this will be endorsed through the careful collaboration between academic staff and clinical mentors in guiding and helping students. Academic support for students/mentors in placements Clinical Practice Facilitators will be assigned for international students in every placement throughout the programme. They will meet regularly with their students individually and in groups in the practice placement. Assessment of practice. The clinical mentor will evaluate students' theoretical and clinical performance. All students must pass both components to pass the unit. 6. The Requirements for Graduation Editor Notes: After meeting graduation requirements, students will be awarded Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). 1．Length of Schooling：The length of schooling is flexible, generally it lasts four years，or up to six years. 2．Degree Conferred: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). 3．The Minimum Graduation Credits：120. 4．Pass HSK 4 (new format)：minimum score 180. 7. The curriculum and distribution of credits Editor Notes: The list of curriculum is only for reference. 1. Curriculum: Most courses are composed of theoretical and practical teaching. Core courses are compulsory, and students may choose some elective courses from other discipline, which is not compulsory. 2. A list of the credit allocation（See Table 1） Table 1： List of the Credit Allocation Table2: Curriculum and Course Arrangement Note: 1. *Compulsory Courses. The total credits of compulsory and elective courses are 160. 2. Students who have passed HSK3(new format) will be exempt from Elementary Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening and Speaking; Students who have passed HSK4(new format) will be exempt from Elementary Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening and Speaking, Intermediate Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening and Speaking. Those students can get the credits of corresponding courses after confirmation. 3. Theoretical teaching: 1 credit equals 16 teaching hours(45min/teaching hour); Clinical Practice & Internship: 1 credit equals 1 weeks practice. Clinical Practice-Ⅰfocuses on Fundamentals of Nursing and Health Assessment; Clinical Practice-Ⅱ Fundamentals of Nursing, community health Nursing,; Clinical Practice-Ⅲ Medical & Surgical Nursing, Nursing care of children, Mental Health Nursing; Clinical Practice-ⅣMedical & Surgical Nursing, Maternal and infant care , Emergency Nursing 8. Introduction of Hangzhou Normal University Editor Notes: The top university & the Alma Mater of Ma Yun. Founded as a teacher training school in 1908, Hangzhou Normal University has a history of over 100 years, which has bestowed the institution with a glorious tradition of producing first-rate teachers and educators at different levels for the whole Chinese nation. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A Copy of Senior High School Graduation Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 2. Transcript of Senior High School Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Non-criminal Certificate * 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 5. A copy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 6. Scanned file of 2-inch photo * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. The physical examination form must include test results for HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. If possible, please also provide separate test reports for the following items: 1. Blood test report (must include HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C) 2. X-ray report -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Statement of Financial Support -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Your financial guarantor must fill it on computer, print it, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The financial guarantor is usually one of your parents; you cannot be your own guarantor. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Drug Test Requirement &Anti-Drug Commitment Letter * 10. Self-introduction Video in Chinese or English in MP4 format Shorter than 2 min, less than 50 MB * 11. Study plan Should be written in Chinese or English. No less than 500 words Includes but not limited to a brief self-introduction, should mainly focusing on what you want to STUDY or RESEARCH after enrolled. You can also briefly introduce your reason to apply for this program in this university in China, and your plan after graduation. It is different from personal statement or motivation letter * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
